strings.ARP_DEF: the Argentine Occupation Zone in Paraguay
strings.ARP_casados_estate_desc:
Even before victory was declared over Paraguay, the Argentinian government already had a family in mind to help them impose their will on Paraguay; the Casados.

With their influence beginning after the first invasion of Paraguay, the Casados have been vastly influential through their business dealings and their lobbying in the Argentine Foreign Office. The Casados suggest a list of suitable collaborators for the government to hire. In response, they request autonomy for their dealings, which Buenos Aires has seen fit to grant.
strings.ARP_king_cotton_desc: Buenos Aires' businessmen, having bankrolled Argentina's intervention in Paraguay, now seek to make the most of their enlarged domain. Their reward, therefore, has come to be cotton, with their share of production far outstripping local farmers rocked by years of crisis and neglect. For the locals, it is yet another cost that comes out of their pockets, while King Cotton and his ministers far away stand to make fortunes.
strings.ARP_despotism_party_long: Administración Aliada de Paraguay - Fuerzas Armadas Argentinas
